## Objective

Use existing knowledge owners and generated-product dependencies for supported upkeep.

## Scope

- Knowledge decisions and lifecycle
- Derived products
- Descriptive documentation and learning disposition

## Entry conditions

- Exact-operation publication and recovery paths are available.

## Exit criteria

- Canonical knowledge, history, capture preferences and required derivatives remain truthful and source-bound.

## Risks

- Schema validity is not factual truth; unsupported meaning stays held.
